name: Boadilla de Rioseco (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Boadilla de Rioseco (a bull on yellow above a bridge and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Boadilla de Rioseco; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
